desc:
Welcome to the Remastered 'Escape the Hotel' obby. The manager has gone mad and locked all of the customers in the hotel, Sales are bad so he is forcing everyone to stay in the hotel. You must find a way to escape. Avoid traps and solve puzzles as you make your way through this crazy hotel.

WHATS NEW:
-23 UNIQUE STAGES TO BEAT
-AWESOME SHOP WITH NEW ITEMS
-COLLECT TOKENS FOR EXTRA PLAYABILITY 
-BETTER ANIMATED CHARACTER
-NEW NIGHT SCENERY

If you enjoy my games please leave a thumbs up and favourite. I make new games every month so stay tuned :)
